reason: The triclinic cell, Z=2, and a P1 average framework are well supported by peak positions and broadly plausible contacts, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern score was supplied, and a direct profile check gives an approximately 10% residual rather than a decisive fit. The trace's profile- and stick-optimized refinements converge to materially different coordinates, especially for oxygen, while many oxygen searches failed or found distinct minima. Most importantly, Pb and Au have very similar Cu-X-ray scattering, and all six Pb/Au assignments over the four heavy sites give nearly indistinguishable profile residuals (about 9.97-10.12%); these discrete element-ordering alternatives were not explicitly instantiated and compared. Thus the submitted P1 coordinates and Pb/Au ordering remain unresolved despite strong support for the cell and average framework, so another solution attempt is warranted.
